notes: The Map A and Map B 2-D PCA plots are fitted on all 400 images, including future verification probes. This transductive fit affects the visualisations, not the headline metrics, which use unprojected full-dimensional vectors; it cannot establish that the Map B advantage is conservative.
All clustering/verification metrics are computed in full dimensionality (4096-d pixels / 512-d embeddings); the 2-D PCA scatters are for visualisation only and are never measured on.
confusion.both_wrong_same_choice_fraction is null because Map B's 1-NN accuracy is 100%: no image is misclassified by both maps, so the fraction has no denominator. Reported as null rather than 0.

512 components were requested, but 400 centred samples have rank <=399. A full-rank 399-component PCA preserves raw-pixel pairwise distances and therefore reproduces its metrics (up to numerical precision). This is an isometry sanity check, not a causal dimensionality ablation: both observed point clouds have sample rank <=399 and the model's pretraining, geometry and nominal widths remain confounded.

dataset.pixel_range is the dataset-wide range [0.0, 1.0] over all 400 images. The old Map A findings quote 0.083-0.876, which is the range of image 0 only; the dataset as a whole spans the full [0, 1] scale.
confusion.per_identity_accuracy_corr_pearson is null because one map's per-identity accuracy is constant (Map B is 100%), so Pearson correlation is undefined. Reported as null rather than 0.

seed_robustness.note: pairwise_2d_rank_corr is Spearman over the 2-D pairwise-distance vectors between seeds, invariant to meaningless axis sign flips/rotations. Full-dimensional metrics are deterministic and seed-independent.

map_a.pc1_interpretation: leading components are illumination gradients — component 0 a broad brightness gradient, component 1 left-right brightness (qualitative reading of the component images in figures/eigenfaces)

pca_axes_interpretation.note: 2-D PCA coordinates (seed 0) correlated with per-image pixel statistics on the 400 Olivetti images; PC1 tracks overall brightness, PC2 tracks the left-right illumination gradient.

seed_robustness.note: pairwise_2d_rank_corr is Spearman over the 2-D pairwise-distance vectors between seeds, invariant to meaningless axis sign flips/rotations. Full-dimensional metrics are deterministic and seed-independent.

map_b.pc1_interpretation: not a pixel image; components are directions in embedding space

map_a_pca512.space: raw pixels projected to 399 PCA components
